title: Goal Completion Bonus on Pocketwire Savings Vaults
content:
A Pocketwire Savings Vault goal bonus of the tier's bonus amount is paid when the vault balance first reaches a goal of at least the tier's minimum goal amount that was set at least the tier's minimum number of calendar days earlier, at most the tier's yearly number of goal bonuses per calendar year and once per goal.

## Bonus terms by tier

| | Pocketwire Vault Essential | Pocketwire Vault Select | Pocketwire Vault Preferred | Pocketwire Vault Premier | Pocketwire Vault Reserve | Pocketwire Vault Private |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Goal completion bonus | $0.00 | $5.00 | $10.00 | $15.00 | $25.00 | $50.00 |
| Smallest goal amount that earns the bonus | $500.00 | $500.00 | $1000.00 | $1000.00 | $2500.00 | $5000.00 |
| Minimum calendar days between setting the goal and reaching it | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 60 | 60 |
| Goal bonuses per calendar year per customer | 0 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 3 | 4 |

## Conditions, each of which is to hold

1. The vault balance first reaches the goal.
2. The goal amount is at least the tier's smallest goal amount that earns the bonus.
3. The goal was set at least the tier's minimum number of calendar days before the balance reached it.
4. Fewer goal bonuses than the tier's yearly number have been paid across the customer's vaults in the calendar year.
5. No bonus has already been paid for that goal.

Changing the goal amount resets the goal's set date. Withdrawing after the bonus has been paid does not take it back.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates and amounts, Pocketwire Vault Select figures)

- A goal of $500.00 meets the minimum goal amount; a goal of $499.99 does not.
- A goal set on 1 March and first reached on 30 May was set 90 calendar days earlier and meets the days condition; had it first been reached on 29 May, it would have been set only 89 calendar days earlier and would not meet it.
- The customer has already been paid one goal bonus this calendar year on another vault; with a yearly number of 1, no further goal bonus is paid in that calendar year.

## Basis Q&A

**What happens to the day count when the customer changes the goal amount?** The goal's set date is reset to the date of the change, and the calendar days are counted from that new set date.

**Is the bonus taken back if the customer withdraws after receiving it?** No.

**Does Pocketwire Vault Essential pay goal bonuses?** Its bonus amount is $0.00 and its yearly number is 0, so no goal bonus is paid on that tier.
